<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Unstage an add or a removal, or stage the removal of a recorded file.

Panel: [Collection](/docs/reference/cli/panels/collection/).

## Usage

```text
huron rm [OPTIONS] REL_PATHS...
```

## Arguments

| Argument    | Type | Description                                                        |
| ----------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `REL_PATHS` | str  | Paths inside the collection. Required. Takes any number of values. |
